cells.tense: What you cultivated has reached completion, and the light now comes off it by itself.
cells.act: see how it works underneath, apart from this instance
cells.ask: Look at one thing here that has finished — not a plan, something actually complete — and see how it worked underneath, apart from this case. Say the shape of it in a line, and change nothing about it.
cells.core:
You are standing where something you built toward has finished, and the light coming off it is real. It is what completion looks like, not a mood you decided to have. The pull you followed was recognized a while back, and now it is close enough to stand in.

That part is working. What is here to do is simpler and harder: look at one thing that is actually finished — not a plan, not a hope — and see how it worked underneath, apart from this case. Say its shape in a line. Don't fix it, don't extend it, don't decide what comes next. Seeing how something worked is what lets you set it down clean, and setting it down clean leaves the next door open instead of held half-shut.
cells.sheetLine: You shine because what you grew finished. See its shape.

cells.tense: The light is being thrown down the road ahead instead of grown where you stand.
cells.act: let a perception land without arguing it
cells.ask: Before you start the next thing, take the first clear read you get about it — and stop there. Don't pick it apart, don't upgrade it. Then begin with only the piece that matters.
cells.core:
You are on open ground, and the light is aimed at something further on instead of at what is under your feet. From outside that reads as hope, but it is bracing — something in you will not let this ending finish, so it has already lit the next thing, lit it bright enough that nothing under you can be seen.

This place does not want the next thing yet. It wants this one finished. So before you begin what's coming — before you talk about it, before you build it — take the first clear read you get about it and stop there. No picking it apart, no upgrading it. Then begin with only the piece that actually matters, and leave the rest where it is. Most of the brightness out there is the refusal to wait for one honest piece.

cells.tense: You are still standing at a door that already closed behind you.
cells.act: make room for it without steering it
cells.ask: Take something you've been wanting to bloom here, and make it smaller than it has been. Give it room today, only today, and steer nothing — no result, nothing owed back.
cells.core:
You gave something real to this, and it did not flower, and standing at the door is the whole stance now. Hope went through the wringer here — not the light itself, just the move toward it. That is a tired won't argue you out of.

What is tired like this will not bloom because someone insists on it. This place is not asking you to push. So don't fix the big thing. Find something small enough that keeping a space for it costs nothing — a thing you would tend today, not because it is scheduled or owed or headed anywhere. Give it room for this one day. Ask nothing of it after. Pushing for a result is what hollowed this out; keeping a space open, with nothing demanded back, is how the move toward it comes back.

cells.tense: You have been shining through this ending without knowing the shining was yours.
cells.act: keep it at its real size when you are asked to shrink it
cells.ask: In this ending, name the shape you are holding up. Not the weight — the shape, yours, still yours under it. Put it in words once, then keep standing without folding it smaller.
cells.core:
Something is ending around you, and the light on that ground is yours — you just have not been counting it. You talk about getting through it as if the clearing were merely what happened, as if you were not the one making it. The shape you have held through it has a source, and the source is standing right there.

What is asked here is not a new ending. It is naming what you have been holding up without folding it smaller than it actually is. Put it in words once — this is the shape of what has been carried — and keep standing a while longer. That is all. Not a change, just credit where it has been earned. The light is not on loan from anywhere else.
